[PREFERENCE] User is curious about flu shots and their effectiveness.  
[FACT] User received a flu shot last month.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The flu shot is designed to protect against seasonal influenza viruses, which are different from the virus that causes bronchitis.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The flu shot typically takes about 2 weeks to become effective and can last for several months.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The flu shot does not provide direct protection against bronchitis or other respiratory illnesses.  
[FACT] User received a booster shot for their HPV vaccine last month.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The HPV vaccine is typically given in a series of 2-3 doses, depending on age and health status.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] After completing the initial series of the HPV vaccine, no booster shot is needed.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Regular cervical cancer screenings (Pap tests) are still important even if the user has received the HPV vaccine.  
[PREFERENCE] User is tracking their digestive issues using a food diary.  
[PREFERENCE] User thinks dairy products might be the culprit for their digestive issues.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for cutting down on dairy include gradual reduction, identifying hidden sources, and focusing on whole foods.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested milk substitutes include almond milk, soy milk, coconut milk, oat milk, and rice milk.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested cheese substitutes include vegan cheese, nutritional yeast, and soy cheese.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended consulting a healthcare professional for personalized guidance on cutting out dairy.  
[PREFERENCE] User is considering trying non-dairy milk alternatives.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Almond milk has a mild, nutty flavor and a thin, watery texture.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Oat milk has a creamy, slightly sweet flavor and a thicker, creamier texture.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Almond milk is often a good starting point for those new to non-dairy milks.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Oat milk is a great option for those who want a more indulgent feel without the dairy.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested starting with a small amount of non-dairy milk to see how the user likes the taste and texture.
